using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using InnoEngine.Mathematics;
using InnoEngine.Scene;
using InnoEditor.Core;
using InnoEditor.Interactions;
using InnoEditor.PlayMode;
using InnoEditor.Scene;

/// <summary>Drives ordinary feature protocols while the actual product draws every intermediate state.</summary>
[EditorModule("tests.editor-ui.workflow-journey", order: 10000)]
public sealed class WorkflowJourney(
    IEditorSceneWorkspace workspace,
    SceneEdits edits,
    EditorInteractions interactions,
    IEditorPlayMode play
) : EditorModule
{
    private readonly List<string> m_verified = [];
    private Guid m_sceneId;
    private Guid m_firstId;
    private Guid m_secondId;
    private Guid m_componentId;
    private Guid m_duplicateId;
    private string m_scenePath = string.Empty;
    private int m_step;
    private int m_playFrames;
    private bool m_finished;

    /// <inheritdoc />
    protected override void OnUpdate(EditorContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            Advance(context);
        }
        catch (Exception failure)
        {
            string directory = Path.Combine(context.projectDirectory, "Library", "Acceptance");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(directory, "workflow-failure.txt"), failure.ToString());
            throw;
        }
    }

    private void Advance(EditorContext context)
    {
        if (m_finished)
            return;
        if (m_step > 0)
        {
            Require(interactions.TryGetPanelState("scene.inspector", out bool inspector) && inspector,
                "The actual Inspector was quarantined or closed during the journey.");
            Require(interactions.TryGetPanelState("scene.hierarchy", out bool hierarchy) && hierarchy,
                "The actual Hierarchy was quarantined or closed during the journey.");
        }
        if (play.lastFailure is not null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(play.lastFailure);
        if (m_step == 0)
        {
            foreach (string id in new[] { "scene.inspector", "scene.hierarchy", "asset.file-browser" })
                Require(interactions.OpenPanel(id), "The product could not open " + id);
            _ = workspace.Open("FlappyBird/FlappyBird.iscene");
            GameScene created = edits.CreateScene();
            edits.RenameScene(created, "UI Workflow Acceptance");
            GameObject first = edits.CreateGameObject(created);
            GameObject second = edits.CreateGameObject(created);
            edits.RenameGameObject(first, "Workflow First");
            edits.RenameGameObject(second, "Workflow Second");
            first.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 2, 3);
            second.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0, 5, 6);
            m_sceneId = created.identity.persistentId;
            m_firstId = first.identity.persistentId;
            m_secondId = second.identity.persistentId;
            m_componentId = edits.AddComponent(first, typeof(WorkflowState)).identity.persistentId;
            m_duplicateId = edits.AddComponent(first, typeof(WorkflowState)).identity.persistentId;
            interactions.SetSelection([first, second], first);
            m_step++;
            return;
        }
        if (m_step == 20)
        {
            Require(interactions.selection.selectedTarget is null, "Closing a document retained a live target.");
            GameScene reopened = workspace.Open(m_scenePath);
            GameObject first = reopened.GetObjects().Single(value => value.name == "Workflow First");
            GameObject second = reopened.GetObjects().Single(value => value.name == "Workflow Second");
            WorkflowState state = first.GetComponents().OfType<WorkflowState>().Single(value => value.number == 7);
            Require(first.GetComponents().OfType<WorkflowState>().Count() == 2 && state.reference == second,
                "Save and reopen lost component order, values or references.");
            m_sceneId = reopened.identity.persistentId;
            m_firstId = first.identity.persistentId;
            m_secondId = second.identity.persistentId;
            m_componentId = state.identity.persistentId;
            interactions.SetSelection(first);
            m_verified.Add("actual File Browser and Inspector: save, close, reopen and reference restoration");
            m_step++;
            return;
        }
        if (m_step >= 21)
        {
            AdvancePlayJourney(context);
            return;
        }
        GameScene scene = workspace.scenes.Single(value => value.identity.persistentId == m_sceneId);
        GameObject? firstObject = scene.GetObjects().SingleOrDefault(value => value.identity.persistentId == m_firstId);
        GameObject? secondObject = scene.GetObjects().SingleOrDefault(value => value.identity.persistentId == m_secondId);
        WorkflowState? component = FindComponent(scene, m_componentId) as WorkflowState;
        switch (m_step)
        {
            case 1:
                Require(interactions.selection.count == 2, "Multi-selection was not preserved through actual drawing.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Inspector and Hierarchy: mixed multi-selection, duplicate components");
                interactions.SetSelection(firstObject);
                break;
            case 2:
                using (var gesture = new EditorEditGesture(interactions.history, "First drag"))
                {
                    for (int sample = 1; sample <= 3; sample++)
                    {
                        int value = sample;
                        edits.ChangeProperty(component!, nameof(WorkflowState.number), () => component!.number = value,
                            "First drag", gesture.mergeKey);
                    }
                    gesture.Commit();
                }
                break;
            case 3:
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && component!.number == 0, "One drag did not undo as one entry.");
                break;
            case 4:
                Require(interactions.history.Redo().succeeded && component!.number == 3, "Drag Redo failed.");
                using (var gesture = new EditorEditGesture(interactions.history, "Second drag"))
                {
                    edits.ChangeProperty(component!, nameof(WorkflowState.number), () => component!.number = 7,
                        "Second drag", gesture.mergeKey);
                    gesture.Commit();
                }
                break;
            case 5:
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && component!.number == 3, "Separate drags were merged.");
                break;
            case 6:
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && component!.number == 0, "The first drag was lost.");
                Require(interactions.history.Redo().succeeded && interactions.history.Redo().succeeded,
                    "The two independent drags could not be redone.");
                break;
            case 7:
                using (var gesture = new EditorEditGesture(interactions.history, "Cancelled drag"))
                {
                    edits.ChangeProperty(component!, nameof(WorkflowState.number), () => component!.number = 99,
                        "Cancelled drag", gesture.mergeKey);
                    Require(gesture.Cancel().succeeded && component!.number == 7, "Cancellation did not restore the start.");
                }
                m_verified.Add("actual Inspector: continuous edits, independent Undo/Redo and gesture cancellation");
                break;
            case 8:
                edits.SetGameObjectActive(firstObject!, false);
                edits.SetGameObjectActive(firstObject!, true);
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && !firstObject!.activeSelf, "Boolean edits were merged.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && firstObject!.activeSelf, "Boolean Undo lost the initial value.");
                break;
            case 9:
                edits.ChangeProperty(component!, nameof(WorkflowState.reference), () => component!.reference = secondObject,
                    "Assign reference");
                interactions.SetSelection(component);
                break;
            case 10:
                Require(component!.reference == secondObject, "The reference was not assigned.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && component.reference is null, "Reference clearing through Undo failed.");
                Require(interactions.history.Redo().succeeded && component.reference == secondObject, "Reference Redo failed.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Inspector: discrete booleans, assigned and unassigned references");
                break;
            case 11:
                interactions.SetSelection([firstObject!, secondObject!], firstObject);
                edits.ChangeProperties([firstObject!.transform, secondObject!.transform], "localPosition",
                    () => firstObject.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(11, 2, 3), "Move X", componentName: "x");
                break;
            case 12:
                Require(firstObject!.transform.localPosition.x == 11 && secondObject!.transform.localPosition.x == 11,
                    "The common X edit was not applied.");
                Require(firstObject.transform.localPosition.y == 2 && secondObject!.transform.localPosition.y == 5,
                    "A single-axis edit overwrote a mixed axis.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && firstObject.transform.localPosition.x == 0 &&
                    secondObject!.transform.localPosition.x == 0, "Multi-selection Undo failed.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Inspector: mixed transforms preserve unedited axes");
                break;
            case 13:
                interactions.SetSelection(firstObject);
                edits.SetComponentIndex(FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId)!, 1);
                break;
            case 14:
                Require(firstObject!.GetComponentIndex(FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId)!) == 1,
                    "Duplicate component ordering selected the wrong instance.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded &&
                    firstObject.GetComponentIndex(FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId)!) == 2, "Component order Undo failed.");
                Require(edits.RemoveComponent(FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId)!), "Component removal failed.");
                break;
            case 15:
                Require(FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId) is null, "The removed component remained attached.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded && FindComponent(scene, m_duplicateId) is WorkflowState,
                    "Component restoration lost identity or type.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Inspector: duplicate instance order, removal and identity-preserving restoration");
                break;
            case 16:
                edits.DeleteGameObjects([firstObject!, secondObject!]);
                break;
            case 17:
                Require(firstObject is null && secondObject is null, "Batch delete was incomplete.");
                Require(interactions.history.Undo().succeeded, "Batch delete Undo failed.");
                break;
            case 18:
                Require(firstObject is not null && secondObject is not null && component!.reference == secondObject,
                    "Batch recovery lost an object or cross-object reference.");
                bool rejected = false;
                try
                {
                    edits.ChangeProperty(component!, nameof(WorkflowState.number), () =>
                    {
                        component!.number = 99;
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected workflow rejection.");
                    }, "Rejected mutation");
                }
                catch (InvalidOperationException exception) when (exception.Message == "Expected workflow rejection.")
                {
                    rejected = true;
                }
                Require(rejected && component!.number == 7, "A rejected mutation was not rolled back.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Hierarchy and Inspector: atomic batch delete/recovery and failed mutation rollback");
                m_scenePath = workspace.Save(scene, string.Empty);
                break;
            case 19:
                Require(!workspace.IsDirty(scene), "The saved document remained dirty.");
                Require(edits.CloseScene(scene), "The saved scene could not close.");
                m_step++;
                return;
        }
        m_step++;
    }

    private void AdvancePlayJourney(EditorContext context)
    {
        switch (m_step)
        {
            case 21:
                Require(play.EnterPlayMode(), "The product refused Play.");
                break;
            case 22:
                if (!play.isPlaying)
                    return;
                if (++m_playFrames < 60)
                    return;
                Require(workspace.scenes.SelectMany(static scene => scene.GetObjects())
                    .SelectMany(static value => value.GetComponents()).OfType<WorkflowState>().Any(static value => value.ticks > 0),
                    "Play did not advance the ordinary script behavior.");
                Require(play.ExitPlayMode(), "The product refused Stop.");
                break;
            case 23:
                if (play.isPlaying)
                    return;
                Require(workspace.canPersist, "Stop did not restore Edit persistence.");
                Require(workspace.scenes.Single(value => value.identity.persistentId == m_sceneId)
                    .GetObjects().SelectMany(static value => value.GetComponents()).OfType<WorkflowState>()
                    .All(static value => value.ticks == 0), "Play mutations leaked into the Edit document.");
                m_verified.Add("actual Game view: Play, frame advancement, Stop and restored Edit");
                string directory = Path.Combine(context.projectDirectory, "Library", "Acceptance");
                Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
                File.WriteAllLines(Path.Combine(directory, "workflow-journey.tsv"), m_verified);
                m_finished = true;
                break;
        }
        m_step++;
    }

    private static GameComponent? FindComponent(
        GameScene scene,
        Guid persistentId
    ) => scene.GetObjects().SelectMany(static value => value.GetComponents())
        .SingleOrDefault(value => value.identity.persistentId == persistentId);

    private static void Require(
        bool condition,
        string message
    ) {
        if (!condition)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(message);
    }
}
